inputs.text: Activists in Uttar Pradesh say the government still has not set out a clear process for brick kiln operators to obtain the required environmental clearance, three months after the mandate was issued. The lack of clarity has caused continued confusion and criticism from industry stakeholders and legal experts. Kiln owners already have State Pollution Control Board approvals to meet water and air quality standards, and say they are willing to obtain the additional clearances if the process is streamlined and free of middlemen interference, which has historically been a challenge. Legal professionals stress that recent court decisions must be complied with and urge the state to address the oversight and establish an effective environmental approval framework. Resolving the issue is important for both the industry and the environment.
